title: Overcoming Addiction
definition: Overcoming addiction is the Spirit-empowered walk of turning from enslaving desires, habits, and substances toward freedom and life in Christ.
summary: Addiction is not beyond the reach of God's grace. Recovery requires truth, repentance, support, perseverance, and dependence on Christ.
christFocus: Christ sets captives free and gives new identity, new power, and new hope to the broken.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Addiction is not beyond the reach of God's grace. Recovery requires truth, repentance, support, perseverance, and dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
